# ai-jury

> Convene a cross-vendor multi-agent review jury: coding-agent CLIs, hosted model APIs
> and local models review the same diff, PR or issue, cross-examine each other, verify
> the findings, and reach one verdict — a chair's synthesis or a panel vote.

A stdlib-only Python CLI with zero runtime dependencies. A hosted-API seat needs only an
API key, no CLI install.

## Docs

- [Home](https://ai-jury.dev/): overview, how the jury works, and quick start
- [Documentation](https://ai-jury.dev/docs.html): configuration, adapters, consensus modes, and CLI reference
- [Coverage report](https://ai-jury.dev/coverage.html): live test-coverage dashboard

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/berkayturanci/ai-jury): source, issues, and releases

## Key concepts

- Cross-vendor panel: each reviewer is a different model/vendor, reviewing independently
- Cross-examination: reviewers critique each other's findings before a verdict
- Verdict modes: chair's synthesis (one model reconciles) or panel vote (majority)
- Redaction and injection defenses for safe review of untrusted diffs
